title: Approving a renew request with no internet half-saves it and says it could not save
what: On Today, the Approve button on a member's renew request is not greyed out when the internet is down. Pressing it sells the plan and keeps that sale on this device to send later, then the request itself cannot be answered, so the desk is told 'Could not save. Check the internet and try again.' The plan sale is in fact waiting to send. A staff member who believes it may sell the plan again from the member's page, which makes a second plan and due.
expected: With no internet the Approve and Decline buttons are greyed with 'Needs internet', like other buttons that need the server, or the message says the plan is saved on this device and to press Approve again when the internet is back.
how_often: only when a renew request is approved during an internet cut
fix_line: Grey out Approve and Decline while offline, or word the message so the desk knows the sale is already kept

title: When 'Try the demo' fails on the welcome screen, the reason is kept nowhere
what: On the first-visit screen, if starting the demo gym or the browser-only demo fails, the visitor sees an error and 'try again', but the reason is not even written to the browser's own log, and nothing reaches MettleUp. Every other try-again in this part of the app writes its reason.
expected: A failed demo start writes its reason, and MettleUp can count failed first visits.
fix_line: Write the reason when a first-visit action fails, and send it to MettleUp

title: MettleUp cannot see whether owners install the app, read what's new, check workout codes or print growth reports
what: Putting the admin app on the home screen, reading What's new, the welcome screen choice (sign in, start a gym, try it), checking a member's workout code and printing the growth report are all kept only in that browser or not kept at all. Nothing is counted for MettleUp, so decisions about these features are made blind.
expected: A small count per gym of these first-week and habit actions, with no personal data, visible to MettleUp.
fix_line: Count a few key actions per gym on the server and show them in HQ

items.reason: Web admin app: heart rate, watch and screen-off parts do not apply. Its timers (one-minute alerts look, join payment look) pause while the tab is hidden and run at once when it returns, with no overlap.
